scenarios.title: A｜接受
scenarios.setting: 临近下班时，领导突然找到玩家。

turns.text: Hey, sorry to ask this so late, but could you stay a couple of extra hours tonight? We need to get this finished before tomorrow morning.

turns.prompt: 关于「突然被要求加班」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. I can stay a little later tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I can stay a little later tonight.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Yeah, that’s fine. What do you need me to finish?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, that’s fine. What do you need me to finish?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: I can stay until about nine. Would that be enough?

feedback.naturalExpression: I can stay until about nine. Would that be enough?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Okay. Let me know what you need me to prioritize.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Let me know what you need me to prioritize.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: Yes, I can overtime tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I can stay a little later tonight.
feedback.explanation: “overtime”不是动词；加班用“work overtime”，也可说“stay late”。

turns.text: Thanks. The main thing is getting the presentation ready for tomorrow.

turns.prompt: 关于「突然被要求加班」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. I’ll focus on that first.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. I’ll focus on that first.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Okay. Which parts still need to be finished?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Which parts still need to be finished?
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: No problem. I’ll wrap up what I’m doing and start on it.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. I’ll wrap up what I’m doing and start on it.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

turns.text: I really appreciate it. I know it’s last minute.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: No worries. I’m okay staying late this time.

feedback.naturalExpression: No worries. I’m okay staying late this time.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: It’s fine. Thanks for letting me know.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s fine. Thanks for letting me know.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Sure. Hopefully we can get everything done tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Hopefully we can get everything done tonight.
feedback.explanation: “hopefully”表达希望事情朝某个方向发展，不等于保证结果。

scenarios.title: B｜询问原因
scenarios.setting: 在“突然被要求加班”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问原因”。

turns.text: Could you stay late tonight? We might need everyone here for a few more hours.

turns.prompt: 你想了解临时加班的原因和紧急程度，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. Can I ask what’s come up?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Can I ask what’s come up?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Is there something urgent that needs to be finished tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there something urgent that needs to be finished tonight?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Before I confirm, could you tell me what needs to be done?

feedback.naturalExpression: Before I confirm, could you tell me what needs to be done?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: How late do you think we’ll need to stay?

feedback.naturalExpression: How late do you think we’ll need to stay?
feedback.explanation: “how late”问最晚到几点，常用于确认营业或可使用的时间。

choices.text: Why suddenly we need to work overtime?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Can I ask what’s come up?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要助动词“do”：“Why do we suddenly need to work overtime?”。

turns.text: The client moved the deadline forward. They want the final version first thing tomorrow.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, that makes sense. What still needs to be completed?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, that makes sense. What still needs to be completed?
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。

choices.text: Got it. Do you have an idea of how much work is left?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Do you have an idea of how much work is left?
feedback.explanation: “How much”可问金额或不可数事物的量；这里把所需数额直接作为问题重点。

choices.text: I see. Is everyone staying, or do you just need help with certain tasks?

feedback.naturalExpression: I see. Is everyone staying, or do you just need help with certain tasks?
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。

choices.text: Okay. I can probably stay for an extra hour or two.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I can probably stay for an extra hour or two.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

turns.prompt: 关于「突然被要求加班」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: All right. I can make that work.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. I can make that work.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Okay, thanks for clarifying.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thanks for clarifying.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: C｜拒绝
scenarios.setting: 在“突然被要求加班”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“拒绝”。

turns.text: I know it’s short notice, but could you stay late tonight?

turns.prompt: 你想说明已有安排，无法临时加班，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m sorry, but I can’t stay late tonight. I already have plans.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, but I can’t stay late tonight. I already have plans.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: Unfortunately, I have a commitment after work that I can’t move.

feedback.naturalExpression: Unfortunately, I have a commitment after work that I can’t move.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I can’t tonight, but I could come in a little earlier tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t tonight, but I could come in a little earlier tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I won’t be able to stay for several hours, but I could stay for another thirty minutes.

feedback.naturalExpression: I won’t be able to stay for several hours, but I could stay for another thirty minutes.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: No, I don’t want to work overtime.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, but I can’t stay late tonight. I already have plans.
feedback.explanation: 这句能拒绝加班；说明今晚不方便或不能留下，通常比只说不想做更适合工作沟通。

turns.text: Are you sure? We’re really short on time.

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己担心的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m afraid I really can’t tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m afraid I really can’t tonight.
feedback.explanation: “I’m afraid”引出可能让对方失望或为难的信息，是缓和语气的说法，不一定表示害怕。

choices.text: I understand, but I can’t change my plans at such short notice.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but I can’t change my plans at such short notice.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I’m sorry. If there’s something I can finish before I leave, I’m happy to help.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry. If there’s something I can finish before I leave, I’m happy to help.
feedback.explanation: “happy to help”表示愿意帮忙，比只说能够做到多一层积极配合。

choices.text: I can pick this up first thing tomorrow morning if that helps.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can pick this up first thing tomorrow morning if that helps.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

turns.text: Okay. Send me what you’ve finished before you leave.

turns.prompt: 关于「突然被要求加班」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. I’ll send everything over before I go.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I’ll send everything over before I go.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Of course. I’ll make sure you have the latest version.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. I’ll make sure you have the latest version.
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。
